recentItems.title: VJ80:British Army Music - Merry Christmas Mr. Lawrence
recentItems.description:
This year marks the 80th anniversary of Victory over Japan Day, which signalled the end of the Second World War in the Far East. This short documentary honours the British and Commonwealth soldiers who fought, suffered, and sacrificed. Many of whom never returned home.

The video features ‘Forbidden Colours’ by Ryuichi Sakamoto, performed by British Army musicians and narrated by Australian broadcaster and journalist Colin Tyrus. It reflects on the soldiers’ courage, their endurance in captivity, and the peace that followed. Music once led soldiers through war; today, British Army Music remembers those who fell.

We are grateful to the Commonwealth War Graves Commission for granting access to Brookwood Military Cemetery, and to Serena Gear for sharing the story of her grandfather, a survivor of the Death Railway.

#BritishArmyMusic #VJDay80 #VJDay #WeWillRememberThem#MerryChristmasMrLawrence

recentItems.title: British Army Music - Jazz & Improvisation Training with Rockschool
recentItems.description:
🎷We don’t just play marches, we also play jazz and contemporary music! 

🎸Earlier this month, our musicians from The Army Engagement Ensemble received contemporary and jazz musical training from @RockschoolExams  and honed their improvisation skills. The instructors gave advice specific to jazz music, broke down concepts such as music modes and application in performance, and drew out creativity from our musicians through riff exercises. 

🎼To find out more about musical training in British Army Music, click on the link in our bio to find out more!

#BritishArmyMusic #Improvisation #jazz #RSLAwards #Rockschool
